# M1-06 — Constraints Register (Scope / Schedule / Cost / Quality / Security)

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-high`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Record scope constraints and their engineering implications
- [ ] Record schedule constraints (4 milestones, fixed dates) and implications
- [ ] Record cost/resource constraints (team capability, free/low-cost tooling) and implications
- [ ] Record quality constraints and how they will later be evidenced
- [ ] Record security constraints and lifecycle-wide implications
- [ ] Identify and explain at least one interaction/trade-off or ripple effect between two constraints
- [ ] Integrate constraints register into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- All five constraint categories (scope, schedule, cost/resources, quality, security) are present with real analysis, not restated definitions.
- At least one genuine cross-constraint trade-off is explained (e.g. "prioritising X security control affects schedule because...").
- Constraints are traceable to at least one requirement, risk, or decision they influence.
